Shmood — Mood-based music discovery

✦ Describe your mood — get a queue built for it, not a genre tag

Mood-based music discovery app — you describe what's actually going on with you, by text or voice, and it builds a queue that fits the feeling instead of just tagging a genre. Personal portfolio project, built alongside full-time engineering work.

FlutterBLoCClean ArchitectureOpenAI Realtime APIWebRTCiTunes Search API

Nutrition score
Scan & confirm
Home & profile
Sanah — AI-powered nutrition tracking
In development
✦ AI health score + personalized copy — not just calorie counting
Download APK

Photo-in, nutrition-out food tracker — snap a plate, confirm what the AI detected, and get a deterministic health score with a personalized explanation of why, not just a calorie count. The nutrition resolver checks a dedicated Nigerian dish library first, then falls back to USDA's global database, so it's accurate for Nigerian meals without being locked to them.

FlutterBLoCClean ArchitectureFirebase Cloud FunctionsFirestoreAnthropic API
  • Four-stage AI pipeline — vision extracts what's on the plate, a tiered resolver matches it against a Nigerian dish library (falling back to USDA, then AI estimation), a deterministic scorer computes the health score, and a final stage writes the personalized explanation
  • Nutrition data resolves through a tiered lookup — the West African Food Composition Table covers Nigerian dishes specifically, with USDA's global database underneath for everything else — so it works well beyond one region, not a single-market dataset with a fallback bolted on
  • Onboarding computes daily calorie and macro targets via the Mifflin-St Jeor BMR/TDEE formula, tailored to the user's stated goal
  • Firestore listeners keep the daily calorie ring and recently-uploaded meals in sync in real time as entries are added or edited
